feature: The playback speed control is a small round icon button
summary: The speed menu on the play bar is now a round icon button the size of Go to End beside it. At any speed but 1x it shows the speed in a short badge instead, so the bar stays compact and you still see the speed without opening it.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Open any video (File > Open, or the sample recording).

try.do: Look at the play bar: right of Go to End is a round speedometer icon, the same size as Go to End.
Rest the pointer on it: it lights up like Go to End and the tip says 'Playback speed (⇧. faster, ⇧, slower)'.
Click it and pick 2x: the menu is the same list as before, and the button now reads 2x.
Click it and pick 8x under Without Sound: it reads 8x with a struck-through speaker.
Press Shift-comma until it says 1x: the badge goes and the round icon comes back.
Press L three times: the button reads 4x while the shuttle runs, then K stops it.
Compare with the old wide dropdown.

evaluate: Does the speedometer icon say 'speed' to you at a glance, or would you rather see '1x' in the circle?
Is the 2x / 8x badge clear enough as a speed that is on, sitting on its faint glass?
Is it fine that the time and scrubber shift a little to the right when the badge appears (24pt at 1x, 28pt at 2x, 42pt at 8x)?
Does the menu still feel like it hangs from the right place under a button this small?
rough: Measured widths (the walk's own control boxes): the old dropdown was 53pt at 1x, 54.5pt at 2x and 76pt at 8x; the round button is 24pt at 1x, 28pt at 2x and 42pt at 8x. Go to End is 24pt.

No mock draws a speed control: it sits in the transport because the placement contract gives that row play controls (UX-PATTERNS placement contract, Transport row). The round face is the mock's transport ghost button (video.html transport), at the same size, weight, colours and hover.

Chose a short badge in place of the icon at speeds other than 1x over a small 2x laid on the icon: at 24pt a superscript on the gauge was unreadable, while '2x' alone in the circle's own height is plain text a person reads at once. A non-1x speed rests on the hover's faint glass so it reads as a setting that is on.
The time and the scrubber still move a few points when the badge appears or grows, as they did with the dropdown (by far less now: 18pt at most against 23pt before).

Two walks clicked the scrub bar at fixed points worked out for the old bar start (x 315). The bar now starts at x 286, so the-scrubber-knob-clears-the-times-walk and double-click-clears-a-range-walk have their points and expected times recomputed in comments. The second was already off its expected time since the knob-travel change (it would read 7426ms against 7200 ± 200).
